identificationModule.briefTitle: Grazoprevir (MK-5172) With Peg-Interferon and Ribavirin in Participants With Chronic Genotype 2 or 3 Hepatitis C (MK-5172-012)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Partially Double-Blind, Active-Controlled, Dose-Ranging Estimation Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy of Different Regimens of MK-5172 When Administered Concomitantly With Pegylated-Interferon and Ribavirin in Treatment-Naive Patients With Chronic Genotype 2 or 3 Hepatitis C Virus Infection

statusModule.whyStopped: Preliminary results of MK-5172 PN003 (NCT01353911) suggested a possible dose relationship to elevated transaminase levels in treatment with grazoprevir.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study will evaluate the safety, tolerability, and antiviral activity of grazoprevir (MK-5172) when administered concomitantly with peg-interferon alfa-2b (Peg-IFN) and ribavirin (RBV) to treatment-naïve participants with chronic genotype 2 (GT2) or genotype 3 (GT3) hepatitis C virus (HCV) infections.

armGroups.label: Grazoprevir 200 mg + Peg-IFN + RBV
armGroups.description: Grazoprevir 200 mg in combination with Peg-IFN and RBV for 12 weeks.

armGroups.label: Grazoprevir 400 mg + Peg-IFN + RBV
armGroups.description: Grazoprevir 400 mg in combination with Peg-IFN and RBV for 12 weeks.

armGroups.label: Placebo + Peg-IFN + RBV
armGroups.description: Placebo to grazoprevir in combination with Peg-IFN and RBV for 12 weeks, followed by open-label Peg-IFN and RBV for an additional 12 weeks.

armGroups.label: Grazoprevir 800 mg + Peg-IFN + RBV
armGroups.description: Grazoprevir 800 mg in combination with Peg-IFN and RBV for 12 weeks.

interventions.name: Grazoprevir
interventions.description: Grazoprevir 100 mg tablets once daily for 12 weeks.

interventions.name: Placebo to Grazoprevir
interventions.description: Placebo to Grazoprevir once daily for 12 weeks

interventions.name: Peginterferon alfa-2b (Peg-IFN)
interventions.description: Peg-IFN weekly subcutaneous injection at 1.5 mcg/kg/week for 12 or 24 weeks

interventions.name: Ribavirin (RBV)
interventions.description: Ribavirin 200 mg capsules twice daily at a dose of 600 mg to 1400 mg based on weight for 12 or 24 weeks

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants Achieving Complete Early Virologic Response (cEVR) in the Grazoprevir Treatment Arms
primaryOutcomes.description: cEVR was defined as undetectable hepatitis C virus (HCV) ribonucleic acid (RNA) at Week 12. HCV RNA was measured using the Roche COBAS® Taqman® HCV Test, v.2.0 assay.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to First Achievement of Undetectable HCV Ribonucleic Acid (RNA)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Time to first achievement of undetectable HCV RNA was determined by measuring HCV RNA at Treatment Days 1, 3, and 7; Treatment Weeks 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, and 24; as well as Follow-up Weeks 4, 12, and 24. HCV RNA was measured using the Roche COBAS® Taqman® HCV Test, v2.0 assay.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline to Week 12 for Grazoprevir treatment arms, Week 24 for Placebo arm

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants Achieving Rapid Viral Response (RVR)
secondaryOutcomes.description: RVR was defined as undetectable HCV RNA at Week 4. HCV RNA was measured using the Roche COBAS® Taqman® HCV Test, v2.0 assay.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants Achieving Sustained Viral Response 12 Weeks After Completion of Therapy (SVR12)
secondaryOutcomes.description: SVR12 was defined as undetectable HCV RNA 12 weeks after completion of study therapy. HCV RNA was measured using the Roche COBAS® Taqman® HCV Test, v2.0 assay.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Week 24 for Grazoprevir treatment arms, Week 36 for Placebo arm

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants Achieving Sustained Viral Response 24 Weeks After Completion of Therapy (SVR24)
secondaryOutcomes.description: SVR24 was defined as undetectable HCV RNA 24 weeks after completion of study therapy. HCV RNA was measured using the Roche COBAS® Taqman® HCV Test, v2.0 assay.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Week 36 for Grazoprevir treatment arms, Week 48 for Placebo arm

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants Achieving Undetectable HCV RNA at Week 12 in the Placebo Arm
secondaryOutcomes.description: HCV RNA was measured using the Roche COBAS® Taqman® HCV Test, v2.0 assay.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants Achieving Complete Early Virologic Response (cEVR) at Week 24 in the Placebo Arm
secondaryOutcomes.description: cEVR was defined as undetectable hepatitis C virus (HCV) ribonucleic acid (RNA) at Week 24 (i.e., after 12 weeks of placebo + 12 weeks of grazoprevir treatment). HCV RNA was measured using the Roche COBAS® Taqman® HCV Test, v2.0 assay.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Body weight ≥ 88 lbs and ≤ 275 lbs
* Documented chronic Hepatitis C (CHC) GT2 or GT3 infection
* No known cirrhosis
* Agrees to use two acceptable methods of birth control during study and through 6 months after last dose of study drug
* Chest X-ray within the last 6 months
* Eye exam within the last 6 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known to be human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) positive or co-infected with active hepatitis B virus (positive for Hepatitis B surface antigen)
* Prior approved or investigational treatment for hepatitis C
* Evidence of hepatocellular carcinoma
* Diabetic and/or high blood pressure with clinically significant eye exam findings
* Pre-existing psychiatric condition
* Clinical diagnosis of abuse of certain substances within specified timeframes
* Known medical condition that could interfere with participation
* Active or suspected cancer within the last 5 years
* Female who is pregnant, breastfeeding, or expecting to conceive or donate eggs
* Male who is planning to impregnate partner or donate sperm
* Male with a pregnant female partner
* Chronic hepatitis not caused by HCV
